DateTypes.description:
Identifies one of the following date types for transactions in the database:
·Transaction - The date range is based on the date the taxcalculation occurs for the document. Format must be yyyy-mm-dd.
·Document - The date range is based on document dates. Format must be yyyy-mm-dd. 
·Fiscal - The date range is based on fiscal dates indicated by each transaction. Format must be yyyy-mm-dd. 
·Creation - The timestamp range is based on creation date. Format must be yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.
·Insert - The timestamp range is based on insert timestamp. Format must be yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.
